Ah, that's right…
Everyone, thank you so much.
Well then, take care!

Whoa!?
W-what's that huge white honey thing?

m320180.ええと……私たち三人は\n元の世界でハニー達の調査をしていたら\nこの世界に来て: Well... the three of us were investigating Hanny in our original world when we were drawn here.

W-well…?
Like Sill said earlier, maybe it just wanted to travel to another world….
m320180.し、志津香さんも少し手伝ってくれても……。: Shizuka, could you lend us a hand for a moment...?
m320180.す、すみません……お力になれず……。: I-I'm sorry… for not being able to help…

m320180.ちょ……、\nあれって、ハニーキングじゃない！:
Hold on…
Isn't that a Honey King!
m320180.で、でも……、\n助けていただくばかりで、\nお返しもせずに帰るというのは……。: But… being saved without being able to repay you feels… wrong.
m320180.でも、いつの日か……、\nきっと今日のお礼をしに来ます。\nそのときになりました:
But someday…
I'll definitely come back to repay you for today.
When that time comes, let's meet again.
m320180.でも、変ね……。\n他のハニー達と違って\nこっちに攻めてくる感じはしないわ。:
But it's odd…
Unlike the other honeys, it doesn't seem to be attacking us.
m320180.でも、見たところは異界の門も\nそこから出現したという魔物の姿も見当たりませんね: But from what I can see, there's no portal nor any monsters that came out of it.

m320180.はあ、はあ……。\nあ、あの……皆さん、ひょっとして軍の方ですか？: Hah, hah… Uh, um… Everyone, are you… are you from the army?

m320180.はい。だとすれば\n再び急に開く可能性も否定はできませんが……。: Right. If that's the case, we can't rule out it opening again abruptly…
m320180.ほ、報告にあった見慣れない魔物のようですね。\nよく見ると、ちょっとだけ可愛いよ: That's the unfamiliar monster the report mentioned. Come to think of it, it's kind of cute…
m320180.ほら、行きましょシィルちゃん。\n……皆さん、お世話になりました。:
Come on, let's go, Sill-chan.
…Everyone, thank you for everything.
m320180.ま、ね……。\n（少しだけ、あいつに似てるかしら……）: Well… (I wonder if I'm a bit like him…)

m320180.わ、わ、わ……どんどん出てきます！\nあ、あうあう、あうあう……。: W-w-what… they keep coming out! Ah, a-uh… a-uh…

m320180.シィルちゃん、ここはご厚意に甘えましょう？\n早く元の世界に戻らないと、\nあい: Sill-chan, let's take advantage of their kindness, okay? If we don't get back soon, that guy… he'll surely be sad.
m320180.ハニーキング……、\nそんなに厄介な存在なのですか？:
Honey King…

m320180.住んでた場所の近くでハニーが大量発生したのよね。\nで、うるさいから追い払ってこ: Honey swarmed near where we lived, and they were so noisy that we were told to chase them away...

m320180.私……シィル・プラインは、元の世界に帰ります。\nだって……待っていてくれている:
I… I, Sill Plain, will return to my original world.
Because… there are people waiting for me.
m320180.落ち着いてください、シィルさん。\n一体なにがあったのですか？: Calm down, Ms. Sill. What on earth happened?

──But before we head out on the hunt,
let me explain what's important about this battle.

m400128.そんな凍った地面を利用して、\n滑って駆け抜けてくる敵もいそうだから\nくれぐれ: Enemies might take advantage of that slick ice and charge right through, so be extra careful.

m400128.なんでも王子と魔物の連合軍が、\n各地を侵攻して回ってるだなんて、\nそんな噂が: Rumor has it that you and a monster alliance have been invading various regions.
m400128.ドッペルゲンガーに連れてこられた魔物や人達、\nそれに慣れない雪山での戦いは\n: The monsters and people the doppelganger brings, plus fighting in unfamiliar snowy mountains, will make things tougher than usual.
m400128.ドッペルゲンガーの変身能力にも個体差があって、\n強い人の姿に化けたからってその: Doppelgängers' shape-shifting varies—just because they copy a strong person's appearance doesn't mean they can copy that person's power.

...It must be those doppelgängers impersonating you.

Deceiving people is cowardly,
and I can't stand that!

Sorry for barging into the office like this!

Alright, Prince, the “Great Hunt Mission” starts now!

m400252.錬金術で作った秘薬は、\n魔界アリの硬い甲殻も軟化させる事ができるので、\nきっ: The elixir I brewed can even soften the demonic ants' hard shells, so I think it'll be useful!
m400252.錬金術の素材を集める為に\n今まで何度も渓谷を訪れているのですが、\nあんな数の: I've visited the gorge countless times to gather alchemy materials, but I've never seen so many demonic ants before….

m400343.「王子よ、其方の度重なる武勇は聞いている。\n魔界でも名を轟かせている王子軍を打: “Prince, I've heard of your repeated feats of valor. If you've defeated the Prince's army that's famed even in the Demon Realm, then I could become the ‘Great Clan Chief' of the orcs.”
m400343.『援軍要請』や、ワルキューレさん達、\nペガサスライダーさん達のような、\nコス:
Let's deploy units like “Reinforcement Request,” the Valkyries, 
and the Pegasus Riders—those that recover our cost!
[18] Also, you won't receive any EXP, gold, or drops from defeating enemies. 
Please keep that in mind.
[19] That concludes the briefing!
[20] So once the Prince becomes famous, even orcs from the demon realm 
will come to challenge us… Thankfully, they're courteous orcs.
[21] There are a lot of strong-looking orcs, so I expect a truly intense battle! 
Please, don't be reckless…
[22] Now, let's begin the Great Extermination Mission!
m400343.あ…！\nいえ、何かされた訳ではありません……！！\nご心配をおかけしてすみませ: Ah… No, nothing…! I'm sorry for causing you worry…!
m400343.それでは、『大討伐ミッション』を開始します！: Now, let's begin the Great Extermination Mission!
m400343.それと、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることも出来ません: Also, you won't earn any EXP, gold, or drops from defeating enemies, so be careful.
m400343.それに加えまして、\n今回のミッション中は出撃コストが回復しません。: Additionally, during this mission your deployment cost won't recover.
m400343.ただ、王子に言付けをオークの部族長さんから頼まれました。\n…では、そのままお伝: The chieftain asked me to deliver a message to you, so I'll just pass it along.
m400343.ですので、一体でも多くの敵を倒す事だけを\n考えて行動させましょう！: So focus solely on killing as many foes as you can!
m400343.オークさんは魔界にいる方達と聞いています。\n不思議に思い、追いかけて様子を探っ: I've heard the orcs are from the Demon Realm. Curious, I followed them to see what they were up to, and they'd set up a camp right inside our lands.
m400343.今回の戦いは\n一人でも多くの敵を倒す事を目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』です: This fight is a “Great Extermination Mission,” aimed at slaying as many enemies as possible.
m400343.以上になります…。王子、いかがなされますか……？\nもし急に、オークの大軍勢に攻: That's all… Prince, what will you do? If a massive orc army suddenly attacks, it could be very dangerous…
m400343.先程、領内を見回りしていた時に\nオークさんの群れを発見しました。: While I was patrolling the territory earlier, I spotted a herd of orcs.
m400343.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは異なり\n『敵を撃破すること』のみが目的と: Unlike regular missions, the only goal here is to defeat enemies. Forget minimizing our own losses—let's just take them down.
m400343.強そうなオークさんが沢山いたので、\nとっても激しい戦いになると予想します！\n: There are a lot of strong orcs, so I expect a truly fierce battle! Please, don't be reckless…
m400343.急いで王子に報告するため戻ろうとしたら、\n見つかってしまって……。\nオークの: I rushed back to tell you, but they caught me… I was captured by the orc chieftain.
m400343.更に、今回のミッションは、\nライフが0になってもクリアとなり、それまでに\n倒: Moreover, this mission counts as cleared even if our life reaches zero, and the number of enemies you've slain will be recorded as your achievement.
m400343.王子、ご報告があって参りました！: Prince, I have a report for you!
m400343.王子も有名になると、オークさんが魔界から\n戦いに挑んで来たりするのですね……。: Once the Prince becomes famous, even orcs from the demon realm will come to challenge us… Thankfully, they're polite orcs.
m400343.討伐に向かう……ですか。分かりました！\nでは、これからの戦いについて説明を致し: You want to go on a hunt? Understood! Then let me explain the upcoming battle.

m500202.……けれど、あの闘技場は戦士達の決闘の場だ。\n奴の御遊びに使っていいような場所: ...But that arena is a place for warriors' duels, not some playground for a demon god. I can't just stand by while he treats it like a joke.
m500202.……とても頼もしい限りですね。\n今後ともよろしくお願いします、アナトリアさん。:
…How very reassuring. I look forward to working with you, Anatolia-san.
Well then, Prince, shall we return?
m500202.……なんだい、驚いたような顔をして。\nあたしがここに来ちゃおかしいかい？:
...What's that? You look surprised.
Is it odd for me to show up here?
m500202.……ま、そんな訳さ。\nくだらない事にあの場を利用している魔神を、\n一発ぶん殴: ...So that's why. I decided to give that frivolous demon a good, hard punch.
m500202.……やれやれ。ついてくるなと言ったんだがねぇ。: …Good grief. I told you not to follow me.
m500202.……居座ってるのは『魔神グシオン』、\n強大な力を持つ魔神の一柱。: ...The one who's taken over is the demon god Gushion, a mighty demon.
m500202.……敗北の味ってやつを知ったんだろうさ。: …He's probably just tasting defeat for the first time.
m500202.……言っとくがこれはあたしの問題だ。\nくれぐれも、ついてこようなんて考えるんじ:
…Just so you know, this is my problem.
Don't even think about trying to follow me.
m500202.……話は済んだかい。それじゃいくよ！\nあんた達、絶対に死ぬんじゃないよ！:
…All set? Then let's go!
You all, you better not die!
m500202.……闘いを通じていれば、\nあの魔神と分かりあうこともできたのでしょうか。: …If we kept fighting, could we have come to understand that demon god?
m500202.あぁそうさ。悔しくて悔しくて堪らない。\nけど不思議なもんでさ、頭はスッキリして:
Ah yeah. It's maddening, maddening, I can't stand it.
But strangely, my head feels clear. I don't even feel bad about it.
m500202.あたしがいる限り、あんた達はあたしが守るよ。\n例え魔神が相手だろうがね。だから: As long as I'm here, I'll protect you all. Even if the enemy's a demon god. So, don't worry!
m500202.あたしはこの闘いで強くなった。\nそしてこれからもまだまだ強くなり続ける。: I've grown stronger through this fight. And I'll keep getting stronger.
m500202.うぅ～……瘴気はないはずなのに、\nなんだか空気が重たく感じます……。: Uuu…there shouldn't be any miasma, but the air feels heavy somehow…
m500202.けどそれは、配下にした連中の為ってわけじゃない。\nそうして闘争心を引き出した連: But it's not for the sake of his minions. He makes those driven by combat kill each other, then battles the strongest survivor.
m500202.ここがかつての闘技場ですか。\n……以前とは随分と雰囲気が違いますね。:
Is this the old arena?
…It feels quite different from before.
m500202.そいつはどうだろうねぇ。魔神なんて、\n大抵は根っこから碌でもない連中ばっかりさ:
Who knows? Demon gods are usually just rotten to the core.
…But there's one thing that's crystal clear.
m500202.そんな殺し合いの場として奴が選んだのが、\nあの闘技場ってわけさ。まぁあそこなら: The arena he chose as a killing ground is that very coliseum. After all, he won't have trouble finding opponents there.
m500202.はい……ですが、魔界を進んでいた際\n感じていた瘴気を、この闘技場内では感じませ: Yes…but while we were moving through the demon realm, I felt the miasma, yet I don't sense any here inside the arena.
m500202.はい、なぜでしょう。\n少しだけ満ち足りたような、\nそんな雰囲気を感じました…:
Yes, I wonder why.
I felt a faint sense of…contentment.
m500202.まぁ、あたしはあんたの仕事に興味はないからね。\n普段なら、ここに寄り付く理由も:
Well, I'm not really interested in your business, so I wouldn't normally have a reason to come here.
But I have something I need to tell you.
m500202.まぁついてきちまった以上はしょうがないね。\n奴の配下の雑魚共の相手はあんた達に:
Well, since you all stuck with me, there's no helping it.
I'll leave the grunt minions to you guys,
I'll be counting on you.
m500202.まぁ闘いを求める事について、あたしみたいなオークが\nとやかく言うことでもないん: Well, it's not my place as an orc to lecture anyone about seeking a fight, but... he's got a nasty streak.
m500202.グシオンは感情を支配する力を持つと言われている。\n戦い打ち負かした相手の感情を: Gushion is said to have the power to control emotions. He can manipulate the feelings of those he defeats, turning them into his minions.
m500202.何を言ってるんですか！ 危険な闘いに、\nアナトリアさんを一人向わせる訳にはいき: What are you talking about! We can't just leave you alone in such a dangerous fight!
m500202.全く、命知らずな連中だね。\n……けど、そんな言葉が少し嬉しく思っちまうとは。\:
Seriously, you reckless bunch.
…But somehow those words actually make me a bit pleased.
Guess I'm getting a little heated too.
m500202.前大会の時もそうでしたが、\n魔界の瘴気が遮断されているのを見るに\n同じ闘技場:
It was the same during the last tournament,
and seeing the demon realm's miasma blocked, it seems clear this is indeed the same arena.
m500202.力を引き出された者達の猛攻に耐えうるには、\n装甲の厚い兵の皆さん、魔法を使った: To withstand their ferocious onslaught, we'll need the heavily-armored soldiers and solid magical countermeasures. Please be careful.
m500202.勝ち続けてるだけじゃ絶対に得られない\n負けて初めて知る闘いの面白さってのもある:
You never get that feeling just by always winning—only when you lose do you truly grasp the thrill of battle.
…Though I only just figured that out recently.
m500202.実はあんた達が闘い抜いたあの闘技場に、\n厄介な奴が居座るようになったって聞いた: I heard that a troublesome guy has taken up residence in the arena you fought so hard in.
m500202.強い奴と戦う。奴の目的はそれだけだ。他の連中は\n自身の欲を満たす餌程度にしか見: Fighting the strong ones—that's his only goal. He sees the others merely as food to satisfy his own greed; there's no warrior's pride there.
m500202.我々は仲間です。\nアナトリアさんが困っているのであれば、\n見過ごす事なんて出:
We're comrades.
If Anatolia's in trouble, we can't just turn a blind eye.
m500202.王子、ちょいと邪魔するよ。: Prince, I'm going to get in your way for a bit.
m500202.王子、悪いけどあたしは少しの間留守にするよ。\n一応、その事をあんたには伝えてお:
Prince, sorry but I'm going to be away for a little while.
I thought I'd let you know, just in case.
m500202.王子、魔神の配下と化した者達は、\n傷つく程に闘争心を引き出され、\n限界以上の:
Prince, those who've become the demon god's minions draw out their fighting spirit as they get wounded,
so they unleash power beyond their limits.
m500202.生まれてこの方負けたことがないらしくてね。\n『敗北の味を知る為に強者を求めてい: He apparently has never lost in his life. There's even a rumor that he hunts strong foes just to taste defeat.
m500202.配下と化した連中は自身が傷つく程に\nその闘争心を引き出され、限界以上の力を\n: Those turned into his minions have their fighting spirit forced out of them as they get wounded, letting them unleash power beyond their limits.
m500202.闘争心の塊みたいな奴さ。闘いに至高の快楽を感じ、\n己を満たす闘いを、強者を、常: He's basically a walking bundle of combat lust. He finds supreme pleasure in battle and constantly seeks strong opponents to satisfy himself.
m500202.魔界武術大会を覚えているかい。\nかつて魔界で行われ、\nあんた達が優勝したあの:
Do you remember the Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament?
The one that was held in the demon world, where you all took first place.
m500202.魔神グシオン、恐ろしい強敵でした。\nしかし、撤退する前に一瞬見せた奴の表情……:
The demon god Gushion was a terrifying foe.
But that fleeting expression he showed before withdrawing…

m900211.……あ、あぁっ！ 対の双剣を構えた\n巨大な神鳥……伝承の通りだ。\n間違いない: …Ah! A gigantic divine bird wielding a pair of twin swords… just like the legend says. No doubt, that's Garuda's true form!
m900211.……いえ、話によれば、\nいずれ世界樹に訪れるという『災厄』は、\nこんな規模で: …No, from what I've heard, the “Calamity” that's supposed to one day strike the World Tree isn't supposed to be on such a small scale…
m900211.……えっ、窓から入ってくるなって？\nそんなこと言ってる場合じゃないの！\n緊急: …What, you say we shouldn't come in through the window? That's not the time for that! It's an emergency—!!
m900211.……でも、もし相手が本当にガルダだとすれば\n決して気を抜けない戦いになる筈だよ: …But if it really is Garuda, it'll be a battle where we can't afford to let our guard down. Even for you, Prince, stay vigilant.
m900211.……ほ、本当！？ ありがとう王子！\nほんっとーにありがとうっ！！: …R-really? Thank you, Prince! Thank you so much!!
m900211.……わっ、わわっ！ \nガルダの気配を察知して、\n周囲の獣達も集まってきたみた: …Whoa, wow! Sensing Garuda's presence, the surrounding beasts seem to be gathering!
m900211.……んふふー♪\nよしよし、後で着て見せてね♪: …Hehe. There, there, try it on later.
m900211.……窓から入るなって？\n気にしない気にしなーい。それよりも！\n戦いの疲れはと: …You don't want me coming in through the window? I don't mind at all. More importantly— have you recovered from the battle yet?
m900211.うぅぅ……吹き飛ばされるかと思いました……。: Ugh… I thought I'd be blown away…
m900211.お願い、王子。\n世界樹の皆だけじゃヤツを抑えきれないの。\nキミが力を貸してく: Please, Prince. The others in the World Tree can't hold it back. If you lend us your strength…
m900211.ここが封印の地の近く、\n射手が巨大な鳥の影を見たって言ってた場所だよ。: This is near the sealed ground, the spot the archer said he saw the massive bird's shadow.
m900211.このあたりにはグリフィンも多く棲息しています。\n風を受けたグリフィンの速度は脅: There are plenty of griffins around here. Their speed in the wind is a real threat, so watch out for sudden enemy attacks!
m900211.このまま放置すれば、\n周囲の集落にも被害が出てしまいます。\nここでなんとして: If we leave it like this, the surrounding villages will suffer damage. We have to stop it here, no matter what.
m900211.この光については、キミの方が詳しいんじゃないかな？\nたぶん他の神獣の『神の威光: You know more about that light, don't you? I think it's similar to the “Divine Radiance” of other divine beasts.
m900211.この場所より危険な場所が、い、いっぱいですか！？\n想像したくないですね……。: There are… many places more dangerous than this?! I don't want to imagine them…
m900211.これほど強力だったガルダでさえ、\n『災厄』の影響のひとつでしかないとは。\n…: Even a powerhouse like Garuda was only a symptom of the Calamity's influence. …So we can't afford to let our guard down any longer.
m900211.こんな枝の上だったんですね……。\nお、落ちたら真っ逆さまですよ……！？: So it's up on a branch like this… If we fall, we'll go straight down…!?
m900211.す、凄い風でしたぁ……あ、あんな強風じゃ、\n正確に射抜くなんて無理ですよっ！: That wind was incredible… With a gust like that, there's no way we can shoot accurately!
m900211.そしたら、その巨大な影の発した光に巻き込まれて、\n気付いた時には、\n世界樹の: Then, caught in the light emitted by that huge shadow, he found himself transported to the foot of the World Tree.
m900211.それじゃあ王子、今回は助けてくれて、\nほんっとーに！ ありがとね♪: So, Prince, thanks for helping this time— really! Thank you!
m900211.それじゃあ王子、敵はあの『神獣ガルダ』だ。\nどれだけ注意しても足りないくらいだ: So, Prince, the enemy is that “Divine Beast Garuda.” No matter how careful we are, it won't be enough—so really, stay on your guard!
m900211.それに、あそこにはグリフィンも多く棲息しているんだ。\n風に乗ったグリフィンの急: Besides, there are plenty of griffins living there. Be on guard for sudden griffin raids riding the wind. We should be extra careful against airborne foes.
m900211.だから、マイコニドやアルラウネみたいな、\n胞子を撒き散らす魔物は入り込めなくて: So monsters that scatter spores, like Myconid and Alraune, can't get in, while wind-loving griffins and beastfolk used to live there…
m900211.だから腕利きの射手が、\n封印の地の調査に行ってみたんだけど、\n――そこで、巨: That's why a skilled archer went to investigate the sealed area, and—apparently he saw the shadow of a gigantic bird.
m900211.つまりはね、信じがたいことだけど、\n射手の報告を信じるなら、\n『神獣ガルダ』: In other words, as unbelievable as it sounds, if we trust the archer's report, it can only mean that the Divine Beast Garuda has awakened.
m900211.でも、ひとまずの危機は去りましたよ！\n――っと、あれ？ この羽根は……？\n虹: But the immediate danger has passed! …Huh? What's this feather? It's rainbow-colored! So beautiful♪
m900211.でも、奴の巻き起こしていた風も止んだみたい。\nなんとかガルダの脅威は退けられた: But it looks like the wind it was stirring up has stopped. I think we've finally driven back Garuda's threat. Thank you so much, Prince!
m900211.でも大きな鳥の巻き起こす風が、あまりに強くて、\n弓を構えることすら難しい状態だ: But the wind the massive bird stirred up was so strong that even nocking an arrow was nearly impossible.
m900211.ところでさ、今日はねー、実はねー。\nごそごそっと……じゃっじゃーん♪\nこれは: By the way, today— actually— *drumroll*— this is me, rushing to the World Tree's rescue!
m900211.ふふーん、それは良かった♪\n世界樹はあれから色々大変だったけど、\nようやく森: Hehe, that's good♪ The World Tree's been through a lot since then, but finally the forest beasts are calming down.
m900211.まだまだ油断は出来ないけど、\n集落まで凶暴な獣が降りてくる事は少なくなったから: We still can't let our guard down, but fewer ferocious beasts are reaching the settlement now, so we should be safe for a while.
m900211.もし強風の中でも正確に敵を射抜きたいなら、\n悪天候での射撃に長けた者の力が必要: If you want to hit enemies accurately even in the strong wind, we'll need someone skilled at shooting in bad weather. Of course, you can also count on us Rangers!
m900211.もちろん世界樹の射手だからね、\n身の危険を感じて、\n即座に弓を射ろうとしたん: Of course, being the World Tree's archer, he felt the danger and tried to fire his bow immediately…
m900211.やっほー王子。元気してるー？: Hey hey, Prince. How's it going?
m900211.んっ……皆さん気をつけてください。\n大きな羽撃きのような音……これは……！: Hmm… Everyone, be careful. I hear a huge wingbeat… what is that…!
m900211.ガルダに加えて周囲の獣達も相手にする\n必要があるとは……せめて奴の風が、\n獣: We have to deal with both Garuda and the surrounding beasts… If only its wind could at least hinder the beasts…
m900211.ガルダのローブを使う時には、\n称号を『神鳥を討つ狩人』に変更すれば\nいいんだ: When you use the Garuda robe, change your title to “Hunter Who Slays the Divine Bird.” Don't forget, okay?
m900211.ガルダの力が込められているのかもしれないね。\n他の魔物に影響を与えるといけない: It might be infused with Garuda's power. We don't want it affecting other monsters, so let's gather everything here.
m900211.ガルダの双剣から放たれる二連の斬撃は、\n強力な威力を秘めているって話だ。\nみ: The twin blades of Garuda unleash a double slash with tremendous power. Everyone, be extra careful!!
m900211.ガルダの羽根、でしょうか……？\nまるで羽が風を纏っているみたいに、震えています: A Garuda feather, perhaps… It trembles as if the feather itself is wrapped in wind.
m900211.ココ最近続いてた魔物の凶暴化も、\n『災厄』だけじゃなくて、ガルダ復活の\n影響: The recent surge in monster aggression, the elders say, isn't just the “Calamity” but also the impact of Garuda's revival.
m900211.シュシュはいつでも楽しそうだねぇ。\nよぉし、私も羽根集め手伝っちゃおう♪: Shushu's always having fun. All right, I'll help gather the feathers too♪
m900211.世界樹に住む獣にとっては、\nこの辺りはまだまだ安全圏なんだよ。\nもっと危険な: For the beasts that live in the World Tree, this area is still a safe zone. There are way more dangerous places out there, you know?
m900211.世界樹の為にも、ここで退くわけにはいきません。\n王子、急ぎ戦闘の準備をお願いし: We can't just retreat for the sake of the World Tree. Prince, hurry up and get us ready for battle!
m900211.世界樹の職人さん達が集まってね、\nガルダの羽根を集めてローブを作ったんだ。\n: The World Tree's craftsmen gathered and made a robe from Garuda's feathers. They say just wearing it can stir up the wind.
m900211.今のが神獣ガルダ……確かに巨大な神鳥だけど、\nでも、伝承に聞いてた姿とは少し違: That was the Divine Beast Garuda… It's certainly a massive divine bird, but it looks a bit different from the legends. …Never mind, now's not the time to worry about that!
m900211.何か使いみちがあるかもしれませんしね！\nこれを集めたらお空を飛べたりしませんか: Maybe we can find a use for it! If we collect enough, perhaps we could even fly through the sky♪
m900211.何とか解決出来て、本当に良かったですね。\nそれでは王子、我々も王国へ戻りましょ: I'm truly glad we were able to resolve this. Then, Prince, shall we return to the kingdom?
m900211.例え風水士の皆といえど、その風がいつ切れるかを\n読み切ることは難しいと思う。\: Even the wind masters would find it hard to predict when the gusts will cease. To stop the wind, we'll have to do something about the beast itself…
m900211.元々風の強いこの地に住んでいた獣にとって、\n風は特に障害になりそうにはないかな: For beasts that originally lived in this windy land, the wind probably isn't much of an obstacle. On the contrary, monsters caught in the wind might charge at us at unexpected speeds!
m900211.大いなる風を巻き起こす、巨大な神鳥の伝承。\nそして瞬時に敵対者を彼方へ移動させ: Legends speak of a colossal divine bird that summons great winds—and a flash of light that instantly sends foes far away…
m900211.大変大変！ 大変なんだよ王子ー！！: This is terrible! It's really terrible, Prince—!!
m900211.実は世界樹には『神獣ガルダ』が眠るとされる、\n封印の地があるんだけど、\n最近: Actually, there's a sealed place in the World Tree where the Divine Beast Garuda is said to sleep, but lately the beasts that live there have become ferocious.
m900211.封印の地にはね、昔から強い風が、\n止むことなく吹き荒れているの。: That sealed area has always been battered by relentless, strong winds.
m900211.最近になって、\n封印の地にいるはずの連中が、棲家を離れて、\n集落に現れて暴れ: Recently, though, those who should be staying in the sealed area have left their homes and started rampaging through the villages.
m900211.残念ながら一人分しか用意できなかったんだけど。\nキミなら間違いなく、有効活用し: Unfortunately we only managed to make one. I'm sure you'll put it to good use. So, what do you say— will you accept everyone's thanks?
m900211.激戦でしたが、皆さんご無事で何よりです。\nこれが世界樹に訪れると言われていた、: It was a fierce battle, but I'm relieved everyone made it out safely. Could this have been the “Calamity” foretold to descend upon the World Tree?
m900211.神獣の力が宿っているから、\n一人くらいならこのローブだけで、\n空を飛ぶことも: Since it's imbued with the divine beast's power, a single person could even fly with just this robe.
m900211.調査に向かった射手の話では、\n奴が空を羽ばたいている間巻き起こる「強風」の中で: The archer who investigated said that while it's soaring, the “strong winds” it creates make it nearly impossible to shoot an arrow straight.
m900211.風も強くて、危険極まりない場所ですね……。\n本当にこんな場所に、獣が棲息してい: The wind's so strong, this place is extremely dangerous… Do beasts really live in a place like this?

m920004.……どうやら選ばれたのは嘘でもないようね。\nでもここから先は簡単にはいかないわ: …It looks like the rumors weren't lies after all. But don't expect things to stay easy from here on.
m920004.あなたも女神様に認められているようだけれど\nそれだけじゃこの先は難しいわよ。: You may have the Goddess's blessing, but that alone won't get you through what lies ahead.
m920004.あら、試練は終わったのよ。\nあなたたちの実力は十分わかったわ。\n喜んで力を貸: Ah, the trial's over. I've seen enough of your abilities. I'll gladly lend you my strength.
m920004.うわさ以上の実力の持ち主ね。\nじゃあ、そろそろ本気で戦いましょう。: You've got the skill that lives up to the rumors. Then it's time to fight seriously.
m920004.え！もっと戦いたいのですか。\n仕方がないですね。\n私の本当の力を見せてあげま: Huh? You want more battle? Very well. I'll show you my true power.
m920004.これは私からの挑戦よ。\n受ける覚悟があるならばその実力、見せてちょうだい！: Consider this my challenge. If you're ready to take it, show me what you've got!
m920004.ただし、私はまだあなたを認めたわけじゃない。\nさっきのは小手調べ。\nここから: But that doesn't mean I've accepted you yet. That was just a warm-up. From here on, it won't be that easy.
m920004.今から与える課題を全てクリアすることができたら、\nあなたを認めて、協力してあげ: If you can clear every challenge I set before you, I'll acknowledge you and lend my aid.
m920004.無念のまま死んでいった戦士は死にきれず\n戦場をさまようこともある……\n亡霊は: Some warriors die with regrets and can't find peace, wandering the battlefield as ghosts… They don't always stick to the path.
m920004.私が欲しいというのなら、\n最後まで戦い抜いてみせてもらおうかしら。: If you want what I'm after, I'll have you fight all the way to the end.
m920004.私の名はマリーベル、初めまして王子。: My name is Maribel. Nice to meet you, Prince.
m920004.私は女神様の声に導かれたもの……。\nあなたが女神様に選ばれし王子？……なら\n: I'm the one guided by the Goddess's voice… You're the Prince chosen by her? Then prove you have the skill to deserve that title—show me!
m920004.私は女神様の声に導かれて、ここまで来たの。\n女神様に選ばれし王子というのは、\: I was guided here by the voice of the Goddess. It seems the claim that I'm the Prince chosen by the Goddess isn't entirely false.
m920004.私も聖戦士を名乗る身、あなたに敵意はないわ。\nむしろどちらかというとあなたの味: I'm a holy warrior myself, so I bear you no ill will. In fact, I'm more on your side.
m920004.遠くから魔法を使えば重戦士など恐れるに\n足りない……\nそう思っていたら痛い目: If you think you can scare a heavy-armored warrior with distant magic, you'll get a nasty surprise.

m920033.……うろたえるな！\nどんなに強大な力でも付け入るスキはある。: …Don't lose your composure! Even the mightiest force has a weakness.
m920033.……まさか追いかけるおつもりですか！？\nそのような危険な……！:
…You actually intend to chase after it!?
That's far too dangerous…!
m920033.「あのお方」がもう次はないと……。\nならばこの身体が粉になろうと引けぬ……。: “That one” says there's no next… Then even if my body turns to dust, I won't retreat…
m920033.あの人たちのように仲間といられたら\n何か変われるのだろうか……。: If I could be with comrades like those people… maybe I could change something.
m920033.お前が王子か。\n私は暗黒騎士団の副団長、\n名をエルヴァ！: So you're the Prince. I am the Vice Leader of the Dark Knight Order, name's Elva!
m920033.ぐぅ……。まだだ……。\nまだ勝負は終わっておらん……。: Guh… Not yet… The battle's not over…
m920033.ぐぅ……申し訳ない……。\nあなたにもらった力を以てしても……。\n次こそは必ず:
Guh… I'm sorry…
Even with the power you gave me…
Next time, I'll definitely end the Prince with my own hands…
m920033.ぐっ……。\n仕方ないが、そうするほかないようだ……。: Ugh… It can't be helped; that seems to be the only option…
m920033.ここが魔界……。\n気のせいか、力が奪われていくような……。:
This is the Demon Realm…
It feels like my strength is being drained…
m920033.ここはいったん引いたほうがいいかもね。\nアタシたちに暗黒の力を授けてくれた\n: We might need to pull back for now. Let's head to the one who granted us the dark power, “that person”.
m920033.この世界と魔界が接近している今、\n上級デーモンならばゲートを開くことは\n実に: Now that this world and the Demon Realm are drawing close, a high-rank demon can open a gate with ease.
m920033.さぁ、行け！ 我のことは構わずに\nやつを追うのだっ！: Go! Don't worry about me—pursue him!
m920033.さぁ王子、先へ行きましょう！: Come on, Prince, let's move forward!
m920033.さあ、早く行くのだ。\n……もう二度と会うこともあるまい。: Come on, hurry up.… We may never meet again.
m920033.そういうところ、相変わらずね。\n……アタシも祈っているわ。: That's just like you, as always. …I'm praying too.
m920033.そのゲートから魔物がやってくるせいで、\nたくさんの悲劇が生まれているんです。\:
Because monsters pour through that gate, countless tragedies occur.
We can't just let you go back.
m920033.その問いに答える必要はない。\n……アタシはただ、アタシの為に、\n戦うだけだ。: You don't need to answer that. …I just fight for myself.
m920033.それでは準備してくるとしよう。\nまた会おう。さらばだ。:
Then I'll go make preparations.
We'll meet again. Farewell.
m920033.それでも歯向かうならば、かかって来るが良い。\nワシの力で一人ずつ粉砕してくれる: If you still dare to defy me, come at me. I'll crush you one by one with my power!
m920033.それにもう一つ、\n君たちには勝てない理由がある。\n聞いて絶望するがいいさ。:
And there's another reason you can't win.
Listen, and despair.
m920033.そんな……。\n私は……あなたのために……！\n王子を……！:
No… I… for you…!
The Prince…!
m920033.ただし、我に残された力は多くない。\n暗黒オーラを使える時間には限りがある。: However, I don't have much power left. The time I can sustain the Dark Aura is limited.
m920033.だが、もう飽きてしまった。\n次が最後というのも「最後のチャンス」ではない。\n:
But I'm bored now.
‘Next is the last' isn't a ‘last chance.'
It means ‘this is the final one.'
m920033.とでも言うと思ったか？: Did you think I'd say that?
m920033.なっ……！ い、いきなり改まってなによ！\n第一、礼を言うのはまだ早いわよ。\n: Wh—! Why are you suddenly being formal! First, it's too early to thank anyone. Say that after you defeat the Prince.
m920033.はぁ……はぁ……。\n魔物たちは倒した……のね。: Hah… hah… I… took down the monsters… right?
m920033.ふぅむ。\nならばまたなにか力を与えるとするか。\n次こそは勝てるように…………:
Hmm.
Then perhaps I'll grant you some power again.
So you can finally win…
m920033.ふははは！ 王子よ、我はここだ！\n先の戦いでは不覚をとったが\n今回はそうはい: Hahaha! Prince, I'm here! I was caught off guard before, but not this time!
m920033.ふむ……。\n君たちは上級のデーモンを\n見るのは初めてかね？:
Hmm…
Is this your first time seeing a high-rank demon?
m920033.ふむ……面倒だね。\n副団長、ここは君に任せる。\nいいね？:
Hmm… troublesome.
Vice-commander, I'll leave this to you.
All right?
m920033.ほぉ……。\nこの私が……脆弱な人間に……。: Hmph… So even I… am reduced to a mere weak human…
m920033.ほぉ……。どうやら次の遊び相手が決まったようだ。\nワシが直々に相手をしてやろう:
Ah… looks like we've found a new playmate.
I'll handle this myself.
Just look forward to it…
m920033.まさか魔界にまで追いかけてくるとは\nしつこい人間たちだ。\n力が抜けるのは、気:
You humans are persistent, chasing even into the Demon Realm.
The loss of strength isn't an illusion.
m920033.もうやめてください！\nあなたの身体はボロボロです。\nもう戦う事なんて……。: Please stop! Your body is a wreck; you can't keep fighting…
m920033.もうよい、団長。\n無理をすることはない。:
Enough, commander.
There's no need to push yourself.
m920033.もしどうしても追いかけると言うならば……。: If you're determined to pursue it…
m920033.よくその身体で頑張ったものだ。\n文字通り、身を粉にして戦う君は\nとても美しか:
You really gave it your all with that body.
Literally fighting until you turn to dust—
you were truly beautiful.
m920033.わかりました。\n団長さんの力を使えば\n敵の力を少なからず抑えることができる…: Understood. By using the leader's power, we can at least partially curb the enemy's strength.
m920033.アタシが副団長として派遣された意味。\n次失敗すれば、「あのお方」はあんたを許さ: My role as Vice Leader being dispatched… If we fail again, “that person” won't forgive you. Leader…
m920033.アタシの技「滅多斬り」をみせてやろう。\n剣の乱撃を止めることができるかしら？:
Let me show you my technique, “Mettachiri.”
Think you can stop my flurry of sword strikes?
m920033.エルヴァよ。我のために\n時間を稼いでくれていたようだな。\n礼を言う。: Elva, you've been buying me time. I thank you.
m920033.デーモンは魔界に帰ってしまったようです。\nゲートは開いたままですが……。:
The demon seems to have returned to the Demon Realm.
The gate remains open, though…
m920033.ハハッ……。\n私は何のためにこの力を得て、\n誰のために戦っているんだろうな。: Ha ha… What did I get this power for, and for whom am I fighting?
m920033.フハハハ、順調よ。\n魔物を放てば王子は現れる。\n簡単な事よ。: Fuhahaha, it's going smoothly. Once we unleash the monsters, the Prince will show up. It's simple.
m920033.フハハハハハハ！！\n王子よ。貴様との決着をつけに来たぞ。: Fuhahaha!! Prince. I've come to settle things with you.
m920033.フハハハ！ お前の人間らしい表情を\n見たのは初めてだな。: Hahaha! It's the first time I've seen a human expression like yours.
m920033.ワシは、これまで君たちが戦った魔物たちよりも\nはるかに強い。\nわかりやすく言: My attack power is 5,000—far stronger than any monster you've faced so far.
m920033.人を救うために戦う、か。\n反吐が出るほど甘いやつらよ。\nフフフフ……。: Fighting to save others, huh? How sweetly naive… Heh heh heh…
m920033.今回は勝ちを譲ってやろう。\nだが、魔界には……。: This time, I'll concede defeat. But the Demon Realm…
m920033.何だね？ \nワシはこれから魔界へ\n帰るところなのだが。:
???: What is it?
I'm about to return to the Demon Realm.
m920033.偵察の兵が暗黒騎士を見たという所はここですが、\nどうやら敵の砲撃部隊が待ち構え: The scouts say the Dark Knight was spotted here, but it looks like enemy artillery is waiting.
m920033.元々高貴な騎士だった君が、\nワシの手先となりあの手この手で王子に挑んで\n無様: Seeing you, once a noble knight, become my pawn and futilely challenge the Prince…
m920033.効果時間内に倒せなければ\n私たちに勝ち目はありません。\nお気をつけください。: If we don't bring him down within the effect duration, we have no chance. Please be careful.
m920033.勝てぬ……。\nなぜだ……なぜなのだ……。: I can't win… Why… why is this…?
m920033.団長に代わって\n私がお前たちの相手をしてやろう。\n行け！ 魔物たちよ！: I'll take the commander's place and deal with you lot. Go, monsters!
m920033.団長！ このままだと波動が強すぎて、\n先にあんたの身体がもたなくなる！\n急い: Leader! If this continues, the wave is too strong and your body won't hold up! We have to finish this quickly!
m920033.幾度も戦ってるだけの事はあるってことね。\n……けど、わかってるんでしょう？: So it's just a matter of fighting over and over again, huh. …But you understand, don't you?
m920033.待ってください！\nあなたは何のために戦いを？: Please wait! Why are you fighting?
m920033.後を追うためにもここを突破しましょう！: Let's break through here so we can keep up!
m920033.我が全身全霊を捧げた暗黒の波動……！\nとくと味わうがいい！: The dark wave I've poured my whole being into…! Taste it!
m920033.我が生涯の好敵手である貴様になら\nあやつとの戦い、委ねられる。: As my lifelong worthy opponent, I can entrust this fight to you.
m920033.我のことは気にせず先に行け！\nすぐに魔界の門が閉まるぞ！: Don't worry about me—go ahead! The gate will close soon!
m920033.我のオーラが消える前に必ずやつを倒せ。\nオーラを出すタイミングは貴様たちに任せ: Defeat him before my aura fades. The timing of the aura is up to you.
m920033.我の身が持たぬことなど、\nとっくに承知の上よ……！！: I've known long ago that I couldn't endure…!!
m920033.我の身体がどうなろうと\n王子を討ち取ることができれば本望。: No matter what happens to my body, as long as I can slay the Prince, I'm satisfied.
m920033.我よりも副団長を……、エルヴァを頼む。\nあれも操られていただけなのだ。: Leave the deputy leader, Elva, to handle me. He was only being controlled, after all.
m920033.我らが暗黒騎士団必勝の陣。\n王子、あんたにこの布陣を\n破ることができるかな？: This is the Dark Knight Order's winning formation. Prince, think you can break it?
m920033.戦闘止め！ 引くぞ！: Cease the battle! We're pulling back!
m920033.新たな敵影を確認！\nあ……暗黒騎士団です！！: New enemy sighted! Ah… it's the Dark Knight Order!!
m920033.早く元の世界に戻りましょう！\nさぁ、団長さんも一緒に！: Let's get back to our world quickly! Come on, Leader, with us!
m920033.暗黒騎士団……。\nまたしても私たちの前に……！: The Dark Knight Order… They appear before us again…!
m920033.暗黒騎士団を発見しました。\n前方に部隊を展開しようとしています！:
We've spotted the Dark Knight Brigade.
They're deploying troops ahead!
m920033.暗黒騎士団長は主に報いるため\n自分の命さえも武器にして挑んできた。:
The Dark Knight commander fought to repay his master,
using even his own life as a weapon.
m920033.次なぞない。\nふむ……、聞いていなかったのか？\n君はここでもう終わりだ。:
There's no next.
Hmm… didn't you hear? Here, it's over for you.
m920033.次はどんなやつを堕落させて苦悩させてやろうか……。\nふむ……そこの王子とやらは:
Who shall I corrupt next for my amusement?
Hmm… how about that Prince over there?
Is there something you desire?
m920033.波動の力に体が耐え切れず、崩壊が始まったのね。\n無茶するから……っ。: Your body couldn't withstand the wave's power, so it's starting to collapse. It's because you pushed yourself…
m920033.消えた……！\n王子、急ぎ後を追わなければ！\nはっ……！ 団長さん！:
He's gone…!
Prince, we have to chase him quickly!
Ah…! Commander!
m920033.王……子……。\n貴様との戦い……。\n私は誇り高く思っている……。: Prince… this battle with you… I am proud of it.
m920033.王子、いきましょう……。\n私たちはこの魔界でとどまる訳にはいきません。: Prince, let's go… We can't stay in this demon realm.
m920033.王子、敵の全滅を確認しました。\n私たちの勝利です！！: Prince, the enemy's forces have been wiped out. We've won!!
m920033.王子、敵の部隊を発見しました。\nこの布陣は……。: Prince, we've located the enemy forces. Their formation is…
m920033.王子、敵襲です！\nあの女性は……？: Prince, an ambush! Who is that woman…?
m920033.王子、暗黒オーラが必要になったら\n団長さんのスキルを発動させてください。: Prince, if we need the Dark Aura, activate the leader's skill.
m920033.王子、暗黒騎士団の主導者が\n戦線から引いたようです。\nすぐに追いかけましょう: Prince, the leader of the Dark Knight Order has withdrawn from the front. Let's chase them right away!
m920033.王子、暗黒騎士団を操る\n魔物も一緒のようです！: Prince, it looks like the monsters controlling the Dark Knight Brigade are with them!
m920033.王子、暗黒騎士団長の姿を見たと、\n偵察に向かった兵士から伝令が入りました。\n: Prince, scouts reported seeing the Dark Knight leader. Let's head there too!
m920033.王子の命など知ったことではない……。\nワシは人間に力を与えて、\n苦悩する様を:
The Prince's life is none of my concern…
I enjoy giving humans power
and watching them suffer.
m920033.王子よ。奴の力は確かに強大。\nだが、我の「暗黒オーラ」で\nその力を抑えること: Prince, his strength is indeed overwhelming. But my Dark Aura can suppress it.
m920033.王子打倒は我が宿命……っ。\n今度こそ、今度こそ我が手で\n打ち倒してくれるっ…: Defeating the Prince is my destiny… This time, this time I'll finally strike him down with my own hands…!
m920033.王子！ 魔界の門が閉じようとしています！: Prince! The gate to the Demon Realm is closing!
m920033.礼を言うためにも今回の戦い負けられんな。\n暗黒騎士団の同士たちよ、準備はよいか: To thank you, I can't afford to lose this fight. Knights of the Dark Order, are you ready?
m920033.私もついていきます。\n王子とならばどこまでも。:
I'll go with you.
With you, Prince, I'll follow anywhere.
m920033.脆弱な人間どもが束になろうと、\nワシに勝てる道理などない。: No matter how many fragile humans band together, they stand no chance against me.
m920033.自身の楽しみのために\n部下の命を弄ぶお前を許すわけにはいかない。\nお前のよう:
I won't forgive you for toying with your subordinates' lives for your own pleasure.
Someone like you will be crushed by us…!
m920033.行ったか……。\nグッ……！ 身体が……っ。\nそれに意識が……遠……のく。: It's over… Gah… my body… and my consciousness… drifting away.
m920033.要するに君はただの暇つぶしのおもちゃというわけだ。: In short, you're just a toy to pass the time.
m920033.読み通り、ここにたどり着いたようね。: As expected, you've made it here.
m920033.貴様、我をおもちゃと……。\n許……さん……！\nぐはっ……身体が……！:
You call me a toy…
I… can't…!
Guh… my body…!
m920033.貴様らの攻撃力を奪う\n我が放つ暗黒の波動を打ち破ることができるかな？: Can you break the dark wave I unleash that will strip you of your attack power?
m920033.進め！ 我らの宿敵\n王子を打ち倒せ！！: Advance! Crush our arch-enemy, the Prince!
m920033.間に合ったようね。\nでも、あんた身体が………。: Looks like you made it in time. But your body…
m920033.魔物たちが多数出現したとの報告があったのは\nここですね。\n王子、迎撃致しまし: The report said a large number of monsters appeared here. Prince, let's intercept them!
m920033.魔物たちよ！ アタシの指示に従え！\n団長が到着するまで、この陣を維持せよ！: Monsters! Follow my orders! Hold this formation until the commander arrives!
m920033.魔界の瘴気は人間たちの攻撃力と防御力を奪い、\n普段の実力を出すことができない。:

m920226.大変じゃない！\nよく見たら魔界カカオだけじゃなくて、\nチョコの魔物も暴れてる:
That's terrible!
Looking closely, it's not just the Demon World cacao,
the Chocolate Monsters are rampaging too!
m920226.実は、魔界カカオが暴走してしまっているんだ。\n栽培がなかなかどうして難しくてね:
Actually, the Demon World cacao has gone out of control.
Cultivating it is quite difficult, you see.
m920226.実際、ちょっと燃えかけていたしな……。: It actually did start to catch fire a bit…….
m920226.巨大なチョコレートの化け物が、\n自分を食べさせてる……！？:
A giant chocolate abomination
is making people eat it……!?
m920226.従業員さんたちが本当に可哀想ですよ……！: The employees are in such a sorry state……!
m920226.恋愛運は最高潮。\nきっと多くのチョコレートが、\n愛情と一緒に届くはずですから:
Your love luck is through the roof.
I'm sure a great deal of chocolate,
along with affection, will be coming your way♪
--- scene: Cacao Bean's Wish (battle, start) ---
m920226.感謝するよ王国軍！\nあんたらのおかげで人を操るチョコは完成した！:
Thank you, Kingdom Army!
Thanks to you, the mind-controlling chocolate is complete!
m920226.改めて聞くと、\n本当によく分からない生態をしているわね。\nカカオ豆の魔物って:
Hearing it again,
it really is a baffling existence.
What exactly is a Cacao Bean Monster……?
m920226.散々グレーゾーンを攻めてきた私が言うのもあれだけど、\nこれは完全にブラックね。:
It's a bit hypocritical for me to say this,
after all the gray-area stuff I've done,
but this is completely black.
m920226.料理は愛情……。\nふふっ、そうですね。:
Cooking is love...
Heh, I suppose so.
m920226.普通の調理じゃチョコにできなかったの！\nカカオ豆の魔物ってどうすればチョコにな:
Regular cooking didn't turn it into chocolate!
How do you even make chocolate out of a Cacao Bean Monster?!
m920226.普通の調理で駄目なら、\n並大抵ではない調理をすれば良いのではないかな。:
If ordinary cooking won't work,
perhaps we need to use some extraordinary methods.
m920226.本人のこだわりに反したのかもしれませんね。\nいずれにせよ、あの様子だと当分は大:
Perhaps it simply went against her own standards.
Either way, judging by her demeanor, she should keep to herself for a while.
m920226.気にするな、グレータデーモン。\n王子や私たちが好きでやっているだけだ。:
Don't worry about it, Greater Demon.
The Prince and I are only doing this because we want to.
m920226.流石に溶岩地帯は火力が高すぎたか……！: The lava field really was too intense……!
m920226.王国の厨房で色々と試してみましたが……。\nカカオ豆の魔物と普通のカカオ豆は違う:
We tried all sorts of things in the kingdom's kitchen, but...
It seems the Cacao Bean Monster is different from regular cacao beans.
We couldn't cook it at all.
m920226.現場監督である私を倒すと？\nしかし、労働者たちからは既に、\n長時間労働で正気:
You want to defeat me, the site supervisor?
But the workers have already lost their minds
from the long hours of overwork!
m920226.甘すぎて、気持ち悪い……おえぇ……。: It's too sweet… it's making me sick… ugh…
m920226.砂糖がなくてチョコが作れないなんて、\n悲しい事態になるところでしたね。: It would have been a real shame if we couldn't make chocolate because we were out of sugar.
m920226.砂糖を混ぜた途端に苦しみはじめた……！？: She started suffering the moment we mixed in the sugar……!?
m920226.砂糖漬けのお菓子になって、\nその甘い恐怖を思い知るがいいさ！:
Be turned into candied sweets,

and learn the true meaning of sweet terror!
m920226.私が美味しそうに見えすぎてるからかな……？: Maybe it's because I look too delicious...?
m920226.私に言ってくれれば、\nもっと安全な輸送ルートを提案できたのに。:
If you had just asked me,
I could have suggested a much safer transport route.
m920226.私は、美味しく食べられたかったんだ。: I just wanted to be eaten deliciously.
m920226.私はカカオ豆だよ！\nみんなに食べてもらいたくてここに来たの！:
I am a cacao bean!
I came here because I wanted everyone to eat me!
m920226.私を食べてよぉーー！！\nみんなチョコが欲しいんでしょーーッ！！:
Eat meeee—!!
Everyone wants chocolate, right—!!
m920226.私を食べろ。そして私に支配されろ。\n人よ、菓子の奴隷となるがいい。:
Eat me. And be dominated by me.
Humans, become slaves to sweets.
m920226.給料をチョコ払いにすることで人件費を大幅に削減！\nこれぞ私の、完璧なバレンタイ:
Paying wages in chocolate drastically cuts labor costs!
This is my perfect Valentine's Day business strategy!
m920226.罪に問われないようにやる、とだけ言っておくわ。:
I'll just say that we're doing this
so no one gets in trouble with the law.
m920226.茶色い豆みたいな何かが、\nお菓子の魔物を引き連れて街を練り歩いてる……！？:
Something that looks like brown beans is marching through the town
with a horde of candy monsters...!?
m920226.街を直したり、人々の手当てをしたりと、\n後処理は必要になるだろうが、\n事態は:
There will be plenty of cleanup, like repairing the town
and tending to the injured,
but the crisis can be said to be over.
m920226.要するに尋常じゃない火力で焙煎したり、\nとんでもない力で砕いて磨り潰す必要があ:
In short, it needs to be roasted with an abnormal amount of heat,
and crushed and ground with tremendous force.
m920226.親切な魔女さんに教えてもらったの！\n王国の人たちはチョコを欲しがってるって！:
A kind witch told me about it!
She said the people of the kingdom are craving chocolate!
m920226.貴方、王国の人たちがチョコを欲しがっていると、\n親切な魔女に教えてもらったと言:
You said a kind witch told you
that the people of the kingdom wanted chocolate, right?
m920226.過ぎたるは、なお及ばざるが如しと言いますしね。\nそれはチョコ作りでも同じことで:
As the saying goes, excess is as bad as deficiency.
The same applies to making chocolate, I suppose.
m920226.違法ルートの気配しかしないのだが。: It feels like nothing but an illegal route to me.
m920226.風水士の貴方……！\nありがとう！ アツアツのカカオマスになるよ！:
You feng shui master...!
Thank you! I'll become nice, hot cacao mass!
m920226.魔界アリといえど、\n砂糖に群がろうとするところは普通にアリなのね。:
Even though they're from the Demon World,
they still swarm around sugar just like regular ants.
m920226.魔界カカオの木は成長するほどに、\n周囲のカカオたちに力を与えてしまう。\n実が:
The Demon World cacao trees grant power
to the cacao around them as they grow.
It's best to defeat them before they bear fruit.
m920226.魔界カカオは落ち着いたようだね。\nつくづく、王国には頭が上がらないよ。:
It seems the Demon World cacao has calmed down.
I really can't keep my head up around the kingdom.
m920226.魔界カカオを栽培しているあなたに、\n聞きたいことがあるんです。\n急ではありま:
We have something we'd like to ask you,
since you cultivate Demon World cacao.
It's a bit sudden, but is that alright?
